messages:
anya: Sales pushed a request: 'onboarding burst credits' 15k token/min headroom for 30 days after signup to help launches. Goal = lower early churn and fewer restart incidents. Quick takes?

mike: Implementation-wise I prefer a per-account ephemeral quota object (start_ts + expiry_ts + profile id). Rolling 30-day window seems simpler for customers.

jordan: Confirmed: two YC startups and a mid-market customer asked specifically for contiguous 30 days (not tied to billing cycle). They want an easy opt-out.

anya: We need to decide whether this is a free promo SKU (line item) or a T&Cs clause. Sylvia?

sylvia: Recommend promo SKU for accounting/tracking. Label as "Onboarding Burst (promo)". Add invoice metadata: promo_code = ONB_BURST_30. Also include auto-expire flag.

emily: Sales wants a Console switch per account and a Sales API to grant extensions. Also feature: visibility in bill preview so customers don't freak out.

mike: For runtime risk: serving will see burstier tails. Plan: enforce per-route caps and soft-throttles (rate-limiter token-bucket) to avoid queue buildup. We'll add a metric: ratio of starter-requests to normal requests per node.

anya: Launch criteria draft: 1) no >1.8x p95 latency increase in 24h canary; 2) <5% error rate delta vs baseline; 3) console toggle + admin API implemented; 4) billing promo SKUs flow through invoicing; 5) comms + docs ready.

jordan: Pilot cohort: pick 5 low-risk customers (2 startups, 2 mid-market pilots, 1 internal) for 2-week pilot. I'll handle outreach and opt-in consent.

sylvia: Legal ok with promo SKU language. I'll prepare a short clause: "Onboarding Burst: temporary elevated throughput for 30 days from activation; subject to standard Acceptable Use Policy."

emily: Ops asks for an audit log entry when Sales grants extension and a TTL on manual extensions. Also want a default cap on cumulative extra days (e.g., max +30 extension).

mike: Agreed. Implementation plan: feature-flagged rollout. Canary: 3% traffic tomorrow morning, monitor CPU/GPU utilization and KV cache hit ratio. If stable 24h -> 20% -> full.

anya: Decision: build promo SKU + Console toggle default ON for self-serve, opt-out via console/support, manual one-time extension via Sales (capped), rollout behind feature flag with telemetry hooks. Action items: Mike - API + rate-limiter + canary; Sylvia - invoice metadata + clause; Jordan - select pilot customers + comms; Emily - admin UI + audit logs; Anya - update PRD and acceptance criteria.

emily: I'll add admin UI mock and audit log schema to the Jira ticket.

mike: Will post canary metrics link when live.

jordan: lined up 3 pilot opt-ins so far, reaching out to two more.

sylvia: Draft clause + invoice sample sent to #legal for review.

anya: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after canary 24h pass. :rocket:
